$description: DG Brand UI tokens, following the Deepgram Brand Starter Kit (2026). Mirrors src/styles/theme.css (the @theme block); `npm test` fails when they disagree. Tailwind utility names are in $extensions.tailwind, brand palette names in $extensions.brand (null for derived tints). Tokens that flip in the dark theme (data-theme="dark" on <html>) carry their dark value in $extensions.dark.

ink.$description: Dark surfaces (landing, stage, top bar, footers) and primary text on paper.

ink-2.$description: Derived (not in the brand palette). A step up from ink, for layered dark surfaces.

ink-3.$description: Derived (not in the brand palette). The 'done' status and diagram strokes.

fg.$description: Text on paper and cards: headings, values, the selected chip. Use it, not ink, for text on paper, so it flips in the dark theme.

paper.$description: The record screen's page background, drawers.

line.$description: Derived (not in the brand palette). Hairlines and card borders on paper.

muted.$description: Derived (not in the brand palette). Secondary text on paper: field labels, meta lines.

faint.$description: Derived (not in the brand palette). Tertiary text and disabled states on paper.

violet.$description: The voice session: the panel, the dock, the signed-in avatar, the active step's title.

violet-2.$description: Derived (not in the brand palette). Lighter violet for layered violet surfaces.

violet-3.$description: Derived (not in the brand palette). Lightest violet, for accents on ink.

magenta.$description: The one primary action per screen, the agent's focus glow, the active step, the live caption dot, the map pin.

magenta-2.$description: Derived (not in the brand palette). Deeper magenta, the end of the highlight band's gradient.

lime.$description: Live, good, found. Also string values in code.

orange.$description: Needs review, warnings. Also booleans in code.

red.$description: Bad, damage, errors, a stopped step.

ring-blue.$description: Keys in code, the open function call's icon, a brand mark's second lane.

sans.$description: Text and headings. Override with --font-brand-sans to add script fallbacks (Noto for Devanagari and Cyrillic).

mono.$description: Product surfaces, code, CTAs, and the letter-spaced `label` utility (the brand sets labels and CTAs in Azeret Mono).

display.$description: The big headlines, 34px and up: the landing title, the caller's quote on the stage, the record title. The same as sans unless the app sets --font-brand-display to Perfektta, the brand headline face, which is licensed: load it only on a site the license covers, and never commit the file to a public repo.

panel.$description: The voice session panel, the highlight band.

caret.$description: The blinking caret after live words, running function calls.

glow.$description: A magenta ring that pulses once when the agent points at a card.

rise.$description: A found record or result card arriving.

slide.$description: A drawer sliding in from the right.

texture.$description: Grain images that stand in for a gradient on the dark screens, already darkened under a black wash so white text reads. Each is a Tailwind utility in theme.css whose url points at /vdui/textures, where `npx vdui-assets public/vdui` copies assets/textures.

landing-texture.$description: Teal grain under a 43% black wash: the landing's backdrop when the app has no photo.

stage-glow.$description: Violet grain under a 47% black wash: the stage during the call, edge to edge under the frosted session panel. Before 0.6.0 this utility was a radial violet gradient.

gradient.$description: The only gradients in the design, each a single color fading out, as the brand does. Each is a Tailwind utility in theme.css; never write another, and never mix hues.

magenta-band.$description: Linear at 120°, Fuchsia light to deep: the brand's single-color fade. The record's highlight band. One per screen.

photo-scrim.$description: Top to bottom, over the landing photo so white text reads. Heavier from lg up (70% → 60% → ink).
